source.attribution: Source: GSI Tiles / 国土地理院; locally reprojected and resampled
source.dateNote: The seamless JPEG tile endpoint does not expose per-tile original capture dates. Retrieval date is not acquisition date. Sources may differ in date and survey resolution.
source.resolutionNote: Zoom-level ground pixel spacing only; not independently verified original-photo resolution. Regional z15, coastal z16 and airport z17.

processing: Only source GSI photographs, mosaicked at three tile zooms and bilinearly reprojected. Tile pixel spacing is not original photographic survey resolution. Capture dates are not exposed by the JPEG service. Alpha marks unavailable coverage. Original OSM island/coast masks and physical terrain remain unchanged. No generated imagery or runtime external map service.
